title.narrative: Modernization of Public Financial Management Systems in Mexico

description.narrative: The Project comprises four key areas of intervention or components: (1) strengthening core public financial management systems, i.e. budgeting, accounting, treasury, public investment and public debt management; (2) designing and implementing resource management systems in federal government agencies including payroll, procurement, and asset management; (3) enhancing the use and transparency of public financial management information, contributing to evidence-based decision-making; and (4) strengthening capacity to support the reform process, including ICT platforms, the technological architecture underlying the public financial management information systems, change management activities, and capacity building.
To improve the coverage and timeliness of public financial information and its use by the Federal Public Administration.
